function xA({ api: e, install: t, publish: n, path: a = "/api/admin/base-map/atlas", decode: o = (i) => createImageBitmap(i) }) {

  async function d() {
    if (!i) return;
    const u = i.editorAssets?.seasonAtlases?.[r];
    if (!u || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(u.sha256) || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.byteLength) || u.byteLength < 1 || u.byteLength > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {

        return;
      }

      c = v, t(c);
    } catch (p) {
      m === l && (s = null, n({ atlasError: p.message }));
    } finally {
      m === l && n({ atlasLoading: !1 });
    }
  }

      return r = u, d();
    },

}
